name: MenuCopyBGToScroll
comment: copies $40 bytes of the BG maps 09:4360/45A0 to WRAM1 and CopyMapToScrollBuffers

name: wPlayerActor
comment: pointer to the player's actor (WRAM4 $40-byte slot; +4 x / +6 y / +$10 facing / +$29 angle)

name: wScriptActor
comment: pointer to the actor slot the map script runner uses (ScriptBegin / ScriptEnd)

name: wMapScrollX
comment: map camera x (high byte = tile column; MapCenterCamera / MapDrawFullScreen)

name: wMapScrollY
comment: map camera y (high byte = tile row)

name: wMapBounds
comment: 4 bytes from the gfx header: min x / min y / width / height in tiles (camera clamp)

name: wMapRecord
comment: 8-byte scratch copy of the current entrance / warp / talk / object / trigger record

name: wMapNameText
comment: text id of the map name ($12C + map index; MapShowNameBanner)

name: wReturnMap
comment: map / entrance / position (5 bytes at $C962) to come back to (MapSaveReturnPoint)

name: wPlayerPosSave
comment: player x / y (4 bytes) and facing ($C2A4) restored when a menu reloads the map

name: wNavDestination
comment: place chosen in NavigationMenu ($FF = Quit or none)

name: wListScrollMax
comment: max hSCY on the event list

name: wNamePage
comment: name entry character page (bit 7 = END pressed)

name: wMenuDesc
comment: WRAM6: menu descriptor pointer ($D202 items / $D203 first row / $D204 blink timer / $D205 link)

name: wCharSelCursor
comment: WRAM6: character select slot 0-9 ($D215 previous; $D20A slot characters; $D216 roster pointer)

name: wMainMenuCursor
comment: remembered cursors: $CABB main / $CABC five-item / $CABD four-item / $CABE character select ($CAB8-$CABA bank 09 menus)

name: wRecordPtr
comment: WRAM6: pointer to the selected $32-byte record in $DC00 (RecordsSelect)

name: wRecordResult
comment: WRAM6: result byte of the records queries

name: wRecordsBuf
comment: WRAM6: save block 3 (records) loaded by LoadRecordsBlock

name: wMatchHoles
comment: 18 bytes: hole won by 1 (P1) or 2 (P2) in match play (MatchHolesUp)

name: wCreditsLines
comment: WRAM6: lines on the current credits page
